name: amzn-feature-availability
notes: Same feature-gap interface as QQQ, on the fixed AMZN 42-calendar-day argmax cohort (90 eligible dates). Shared archive preparation followed by identical 155-field/13-family checks. No imputation, feature computation, training, PCA or selection. Family contracts describe required feature semantics, not certification that those sources exist. No historical known-at certification follows from finite values.

snapshots.notes: One snapshot per contract/session per pinned archive. Conflicting same-session observations refuse during onboarding rather than choose silently.

labels.notes: Underlying expiry-close labels, not exercise or cash settlement. Future and unverified closes remain null.

panel.notes: Historical trade-close American-option proxy; finite-support completed tails are not observed. Current orphan metadata stays visible but ineligible. Numerical projection/forward diagnostics are ungated unless JSON supplies limits.

cohort.notes: Hold the 90-date exact-42-day eligible AMZN cohort selected by the existing coverage run fixed; do not shrink it for feature gaps.

check_implied_cdf.notes: same entry chain. after-close reconstruction; no intraday availability claim. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_return_history.notes: 22 prior exchange-session returns including entry close. backward-only daily-close reconstruction. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_realized_volatility.notes: up to 66 exchange-session returns. backward-only daily-close reconstruction. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_ohlc_shape.notes: up to 22 OHLC sessions plus prior close. requires full-cohort materialization from local OHLC source. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_volatility_context.notes: last observation within configured maximum age (7 calendar days). date-level backward join; release timestamp not certified. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_expanded_volatility_context.notes: last observation within 7 calendar days; duplicate VXN omitted. requires full-cohort materialization and release-clock audit. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_surface_level.notes: same entry chain. after-close reconstruction; observed quotes. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_surface_changes.notes: 1/5/22 prior observations within expiry, not necessarily exchange sessions. same-series backward changes; term slope ordering used realized DTE, needs prospective scheduled-DTE rebuild. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_variance_gap.notes: same-expiry IV, scheduled sessions, prior 22-session variance. requires full-cohort materialization from existing fields. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_liquidity.notes: same entry snapshot. after-close snapshot proxies, not executable quotes or signed dealer positions. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_positioning_changes.notes: same snapshot plus prior same-contract open interest. requires full-cohort materialization and OI publication-clock audit. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_macro_context.notes: daily sources lagged one declared exchange session; weekly seven days; age guards. historical release/vintage not certified; finite values are not proof of entry-known availability. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_chain_nodes.notes: same entry chain within configured moneyness gap. after-close reconstruction; all nine masks required for full-family completeness. This flag tests materialized finite completeness only, not historical known-at certification.

check_intersection.notes: All-family intersection is diagnostic, never an instruction to discard the baseline cohort.

check_core.notes: Predeclared completeness intersection; does not drop any cohort row.

check_core_surface.notes: Predeclared completeness intersection; does not drop any cohort row.

params.provenance_waiver: Each compact gap record explicitly names its feature and forecast identity.

all_feature_gaps.notes: Every missing/invalid feature observation, including wholly absent feature columns. Empty feature contributions mean zero gaps.

params.source: Exact QQQ cohort identities and feature gap reasons; field_absent distinguishes absent materialization from null_value

params.provenance_waiver: Each family gap names the rejected family and forecast identity; family_contracts declares required fields and quality predicates.

params.source: Exact dates failing family completeness/age/mask checks; join feature-gaps by date/expiry and consult hash-bound family_contracts for quality predicates

archive.cdf: American-option historical trade-close proxy; asynchronous prices, not observed contemporaneous quotes or physical probabilities
archive.underlying_features: Returns/RV/OHLC can be investigated from pinned underlying history, but are not materialized in OptionCDFPanel records
archive.chain_features: Historical trade bars do not provide historical bid/ask, IV, Greeks or OI; current-chain values must not be backfilled
archive.market_macro: Not joined by this preparation; family requirements do not establish raw source absence or known-at vintage
archive.gap_semantics: field_absent means absent from prepared row, not necessarily absent from raw sources
archive.family_contracts: Same desired feature definitions and checks as QQQ; inspect source limitations here before interpreting inherited clock requirements

feature_profile.notes: Finite numeric values versus absent/null/nonfinite. Presence does not establish publication time, historical vintage, or node-mask admission.

present_flag.notes: Present means a non-null field; finite_flag separately rejects nonnumeric/NaN/infinity.
